subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 166 (EVOL-4). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the subject; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition), TR (transformation) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From TRS: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and INFO-INTG (information integration). From INFO-INTG: RE-DEF (redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From TR: COS-P (cosmic particulars). From COS-P: C-CONT (composite continuance). From PROG-CONT: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: RE-DOC (redocumentation).
